name: Arrangement-Factorizable Partial Cubes Are Product-Closed
statement: The Cartesian product of two finite partial cubes with arrangement-type Varchenko factorizations again has an arrangement-type factorization.
proof: The product determinant is a product of powers of the two factor determinants on disjoint variable sets, so all factors retain the form $(1-x_A^2)^{b_A}$ with nonnegative exponents.
